values.description: Base domain of the installation. The platform is platform.<baseDomain> and each tenant is <tenantSlug>.<baseDomain>. Append :port when the gateway is not on 443.
Slug of the tenant this run registers and then works in. Every tenant URL derives from it.
Display name used when the tenant is registered.
Platform operator account created during Admin Console setup.
Password the tenant owner chooses during the one-time activation in folder 04.
